tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Returns the current health and timestamp of the NewTqnia server.

tools.name: get_recent_news
tools.description: Returns published news from the past X days (90 by default). Administrators get bilingual titles, summaries, and URLs; other accounts get a single locale (pass the caller's language in locale) with a title, summary, and canonical URL to read the full article.
